Detailed map showing five positions and the tracks of the vessels during the sea battle, obstructions, channels, banks, and shoals. Includes small views of the "Iron-clad Tennessee," Federal ship colliding with the Ram Tennessee, a vessel sailing past what appears to be Mobile Point, and a general view of the battle. Inset: [Diagram] showing points of collision of different vessels upon the Ram [Tennessee]. 19 x 15 cm. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:22,500.
